tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search job listings by keyword, location, type, or remote policy. Returns paginated results with title, company, salary, and application URL.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get full details of a job listing by its slug or ID, including description, requirements, company info, and application link.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Fetch the latest news articles. Optionally filter by category, locale, or title keyword. Returns title, summary, publication date, and URL.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List all content categories available on the platform (for filtering news, jobs, etc.).

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search companies on the platform. Returns company name, industry, location, size, website, and open roles count.

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Get high-level statistics about the Datronis platform: total active jobs, jobs indexed in the last 7 days, companies, countries represented, news articles, and users.

tools.name: apply_to_job
tools.description: Submit a job application on behalf of the authenticated user. Requires a personal access token (generate one at /app/api-keys/). A resume is mandatory: if no resume_id is given, the user's default (or most recently updated) resume is used automatically, and the call fails with a clear error if the u

tools.name: list_my_resumes
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved resumes. Requires a personal access token (generate one at /app/api-keys/).

tools.name: get_my_applications
tools.description: Check the status of the authenticated user's job applications. Requires a personal access token (generate one at /app/api-keys/).

tools.name: draft_news
tools.description: Draft and publish a news article. Open to anyone with a Datronis account — the personal access token is for rate-limiting and audit, not permission-gating. tools.name: resubmit_news
tools.description: Revise and reclassify a news article that draft_news (or a previous resubmit_news call) rejected as "flagged". tools.name: get_missing_news_translations
tools.description: List published English news articles and which locale codes they are still missing a translation for. Pass locale to focus on one language at a time. Use this to find work for submit_news_translation — this tool only reports gaps, it never translates anything itself.

tools.name: submit_news_translation
tools.description: Publish your own translation of an already-published English article into a new locale. Unlike draft_news's target_locales (which asks Datronis's own server to translate it), the translated title/body you pass here is published as-is — you (the calling AI) do the translation. tools.name: admin_edit_news
tools.description: Admin-only: edit any existing news article — title, body, category, or published status — regardless of who created it or what locale it is in. Requires an api_key belonging to an admin account. Unlike resubmit_news, there is no ownership restriction and no safety classifier; omit a field to leave i

tools.name: admin_translate_news
tools.description: Admin-only: durably queue server-generated translations for an existing published news article. Pass target_locales for selected languages, or omit it to fill every missing locale across all 24 supported languages. Existing translations are skipped and each locale has a deterministic task, so repeat

tools.name: admin_get_news_translation_status
tools.description: Admin-only: inspect translation coverage and durable queue state for a news article. Returns existing locale rows, missing locale codes, per-locale QUEUED/PROCESSING/COMPLETED/FAILED jobs, and complete=true only when all 24 languages exist.

tools.name: create_resume
tools.description: Create a new resume for the authenticated user by directly specifying its content — name, headline, summary, contact info, work experience, education, skills, projects, certificates. Unlike the human resume builder at /app/resume-builder/, this tool skips layout and styling entirely — Datronis appli

tools.name: update_resume
tools.description: Update an existing resume's content and/or metadata (title, locale, status, default flag). By default this merges: fields you omit stay as they are, and any section array you DO send (experiences, education, skills, projects, certificates, customSections) replaces that one section while every other

tools.name: list_memo_decks
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Memo flashcard decks with card counts, how many cards are due today, and each deck's front/back language. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

tools.name: create_memo_deck
tools.description: Create a new Memo flashcard deck, optionally with its first cards (up to 200). For language learning set front_lang/back_lang (BCP-47, e.g. "es-ES" / "en-US") so the user hears correct free text-to-speech in the browser. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

tools.name: update_memo_deck
tools.description: Rename or restyle a Memo deck, or change its front/back language. Only fields you pass change. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

tools.name: list_memo_cards
tools.description: List or search flashcards. With deck_id: that deck's cards (newest first). With only a query: search across all the user's decks — use this to find "the card about X" before editing or reviewing it. Every card includes `schedule`: stage (new/learning/review/mature), step, interval_days, due_date and

tools.name: get_memo_card
tools.description: Get one flashcard and exactly where it sits in its spaced-repetition cycle: stage, step (consecutive successful recalls), interval, ease, next due date, lapses, its position in the deck's study queue (queue_position of queue_size), and its last 10 reviews. Requires a personal access token with the "

tools.name: add_memo_cards
tools.description: Add 1–500 flashcards to a deck in one call, or update existing ones. mode "add" (default) skips exact duplicates (same front AND back, ignoring case and spacing), so re-sending a list is safe; mode "update" overwrites the answer of cards whose front already exists, keeping their review progress. Ret

tools.name: export_memo_deck
tools.description: Export every card of a deck (front, back, hint, tags) plus the deck's settings as JSON — for a backup, for converting the deck to another format for the user, or for copying it elsewhere. The same shape can be imported back with add_memo_cards or the web importer. Requires a personal access token wi

tools.name: update_memo_card
tools.description: Edit a flashcard's front, back, hint or tags. Only fields you pass change; the card keeps its review schedule. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

tools.name: get_memo_study_queue
tools.description: Get the cards due today (reviews first, then new cards) so you can quiz the user in chat: show the front, let them answer, reveal the back, then call review_memo_card with how well they did. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

tools.name: review_memo_card
tools.description: Record the user's answer to a flashcard and reschedule it (SM-2 spaced repetition) — exactly the same as rating it in the web app, and it counts toward their activity calendar and streak. Also use this when the user says they already know a card ("easy" pushes it days ahead). Returns the card's new

tools.name: get_memo_activity
tools.description: The user's study activity per day (reviews, correct answers, cards added), current and longest streak, and retention %. Use it to encourage them or to say which days they studied. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List the user's Datronis forms (and forms shared with them) with status, mode, response counts and public links. Requires a personal access token with the "forms" scope.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Get one form: its questions (with block ids for update_form), logic, theme, settings, validation issues and public link. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: create_form
tools.description: Create a form (as a draft). Give a plain-language description and Datronis designs the questions, or pass exact questions, or start from a template. The form is checked like any human-made form and cannot ask for passwords, card numbers, one-time codes or recovery phrases. Call publish_form to make

tools.name: update_form
tools.description: Edit a form's draft with a list of operations (add/update/remove/move questions, set title/theme/layout). All-or-nothing; returns the updated form and validation issues. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: publish_form
tools.description: Publish the current draft so respondents see it, returning the public link. If the change affects questions that already have answers, it is refused unless confirm_data_impact is true. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: set_form_status
tools.description: Close a published form (stop accepting responses) or reopen it. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: list_form_responses
tools.description: List submitted responses to a form (answers keyed by block id; get_form maps ids to questions). Reviewers only see responses assigned to them; blind review hides identities. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: get_form_response
tools.description: Get one response with answers, score, files (short-lived download links), reviews and pipeline stage. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: get_form_summary
tools.description: Aggregated results per question (counts, averages, NPS, rankings incl. instant-runoff winners) plus views, completion rate and the drop-off funnel. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: get_form_insights
tools.description: AI insights on a form's responses: a summary, main themes with verbatim quotes, mood and suspicious responses. Sensitive answers are never analysed. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: update_form_response
tools.description: Manage a response: move it to a pipeline stage (moves its Kanban card too), tag, star or add private notes. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: review_form_response
tools.description: Fill in or update your interview/application scorecard for a response. Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: export_form_responses
tools.description: Export all responses as CSV text or JSON (up to 2,000 rows here; use the web app for larger exports and Excel). Requires the "forms" scope.

tools.name: list_diagrams
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved diagrams (name, theme, public flag, timestamps — not the full Mermaid source; call get_diagram for that). Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

tools.name: get_diagram
tools.description: Get one diagram's full Mermaid source, theme, Global Settings, and node overrides. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Create a new diagram from Mermaid source — flowcharts, sequence diagrams, mind maps, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, and anything else Mermaid supports. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

tools.name: update_diagram
tools.description: Update a diagram: rename it, replace its Mermaid source entirely, change its theme or Global Settings, or set its node overrides. Only fields you pass change — to edit the diagram's content, pass the complete new `code`, not a fragment. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

tools.name: delete_diagram
tools.description: Permanently delete a diagram. Cannot be undone. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

tools.name: duplicate_diagram
tools.description: Copy an existing diagram (including one that is public but not yours) into a new diagram you own. Requires a personal access token with the "diagram" scope.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_news, list_memo_cards, get_memo_card, add_memo_cards, get_memo_study_queue, get_memo_activity, get_form, update_form, list_form_responses, get_form_response · Private data: apply_to_job, list_my_resumes, get_my_applications, draft_news, create_resume, update_resume, list_memo_decks, create_memo_deck, update_memo_deck, list_memo_cards, get_memo_card, add_memo_cards, export_memo_deck, update_memo_card, get_memo_study_queue, review_memo_card, get_memo_activity, list_forms, create_form, get_form_response, update_form_response, list_diagrams, get_diagram, create_diagram, update_diagram, delete_diagram, duplicate_diagram · Public sink: apply_to_job, draft_news, submit_news_translation, admin_create_news, update_resume, publish_form · Destructive: export_memo_deck, update_form, get_form_summary, delete_diagram.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_news, list_memo_cards, get_memo_card, add_memo_cards, get_memo_study_queue, get_memo_activity, get_form, update_form, list_form_responses, get_form_response · Private data: apply_to_job, list_my_resumes, get_my_applications, draft_news, create_resume, update_resume, list_memo_decks, create_memo_deck, update_memo_deck, list_memo_cards, get_memo_card, add_memo_cards, export_memo_deck, update_memo_card, get_memo_study_queue, review_memo_card, get_memo_activity, list_forms, create_form, get_form_response, update_form_response, list_diagrams, get_diagram, create_diagram, update_diagram, delete_diagram, duplicate_diagram · Public sink: apply_to_job, draft_news, submit_news_translation, admin_create_news, update_resume, publish_form · Destructive: export_memo_deck, update_form, get_form_summary, delete_diagram

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
